reviews.title: Responsive seller, NOS drives with 0 hours. Can't beat it.
reviews.comment: I just installed these drives into my 8-wide RaidZ2 vdev, so I will follow up later on if I encounter any issues. However, I appreciate being able to buy these new old stock drives at a great, great price. Be warned that the actual warranty from the seller is 1 year (although they offered me the 5 year due to the discrepancy), and that I didn't get much clarity on exactly what is covered by it. That being said, my new drives are performing well and I'll be ordering more. 3 or 6 month update to follow.
reviews.author: Tim H.

reviews.title: Drives failed in hours
reviews.comment: Purchased 4 drives to replace 2 in my server and have a few cold spares.  Installed the first two, started a resilver, and the drives failed less than 20 hours later. Installed the second two to replace those, didn't even get through the resilver before both drives failed.  Total time installed in the system is 2 hours. Drives showing many read and write errors.  All 4 immediately failed.  I would avoid and find other drives.
reviews.author: Emason

reviews.title: failed within 4 months
reviews.comment: ordered 3 of these a few months ago to replace some dying drives in my SAN. Already have a complete failure within 4 months. I know these are refurb, but that's atrociously bad for the price.
